decision: Hold; do not post READY. Read-only proof reduces guards/instructions but real-workload CPU directions differ and median cycles regress slightly. Continue simpler direct zero-test emission independently. Code and all native reports remain together on this unmerged feature branch; main must not receive or count these outcomes as current implementation evidence.

operation.scope: Bespoke same-source operation benchmark; not Test262 coverage. proc_pid_rusage V4 instruction/cycle and user/system CPU counters converted through mach_timebase_info, sampled every 1 ms between initial stop and final exit. CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.
